svg.title: DTP top-level architecture
svg.desc: Block diagram of the DTP top module, dtp, which holds the JTAG interface unit u_jtag_intf_unit and the cross-trigger network u_cross_trigger_network. In the JTAG interface unit the primary TAP u_jtag_ptap takes the chiplet JTAG pins on its TAP controller and 6-bit instruction register, and reports the TAP state and decoded instruction. Its scan mux forwards TDI to every data register and selects the return for TDO. Its internal data registers include DEBUG_CONTROL, which drives the JTAG clock stop into the cross-trigger network, reads back the CLA clock-stop status and drives the CLA clock-stop enable and the boot-stall override to the SMC, and IC_RESET, which drives the SMC, SEP and external reset overrides. Three optional JTAG2AXI bridges are AXI managers: u_smc_jtag2axi to the SMC fabric jtag_axi_in port over AXI4, u_smc_otp_jtag2axi to the SMC eFuse wrapper and u_sep_otp_jtag2axi to the SEP OTP, both over AXI-Lite. The scan mux also reaches the external boundary-scan chain; the secondary TAP chain of four optional STAPs, u_stap_io to the next chiplet, u_stap_smc_dbg to the SMC CPU debug TAP, u_stap_sep_dbg to the SEP CPU debug TAP and u_stap_extra to local TAPs, followed by an external STAP chain; and the iJTAG chain of three SIBs, u_dft_secure_sib, u_dft_nonsecure_sib and u_dfd_sib, each opening an external scan segment. The debug-disable synchroniser takes dbg_disable_i from the SEP lifecycle controller into the TCK domain and gates each STAP, each SIB and each bridge. In the cross-trigger network the AXI-Lite CSR crossbar u_axil_xbar takes the DTP CSR window from the SMC peripheral crossbar and reaches the cross-trigger matrix u_ctm and the sixteen external cross-trigger ports u_ctp. The 26 by 26 matrix connects the sixteen external ports, which drive the CTP pads, and the ten internal port cores u_int_ctp_core, which carry the internal cross-triggers: two lanes to and from the SMC DFD CLA and eight to SMU ports. The clock-stop control u_clock_stop_ctrl ORs the nine clock-stop requests with the JTAG clock stop and drives stop_clks_o.
